sources.title: Pratibha Ray · Jajnaseni
sources.note: Author-hosted Jajnaseni excerpt: Draupadi’s reflections on attachment, the Himalayan ascent and her fall. The English excerpt does not identify its translator.
sources.inspection: Actual author-hosted English excerpt freshly retrieved and inspected20October2026: three gunas, iron/gold attachment comparison, Himalayan ascent, self-questioning and fall. Translator not labelled; no full-novel or Odia/Sanskrit collation. Original paraphrase only, no excerpt reproduced.

sources.title: Pratibha Ray · Works adapted for screen and stage
sources.note: Ray’s adaptation account lists Hema Malini’s Jajnaseni stage ballet and an Odissi ballet based on Mahamoha. Production dates are not supplied.
sources.inspection: Author’s adaptation account freshly retrieved and read20October2026: Hema Malini Jajnaseni stage ballet and Mahamoha/Ahalya Odissi ballet. No production dates, performance analysis or current availability inferred.
